name: FSL Probabilistic Tractography Algorithm
summary: Runs FSL probtrackx2 (GPU) surface-seeded probabilistic tractography from BedpostX samples, with avoid, target and termination masks, for one hemisphere.
description: Wraps probtrackx2_gpu with fixed settings (50000 samples, 3200 steps, 0.3125 mm step, loop check, modified Euler, caret mesh space) and outputs streamline density and seed-to-target counts. Seeds come from a GIFTI surface for the chosen hemisphere, with the FA map as seed reference. Used for surface-based tractography of prefrontal pathways (Bedini et al., 2026). Needs BedpostX output and all masks in diffusion space.

inputs.description: Seed surfaces (GIFTI) for the left and right hemispheres.
Tensor maps; FA is used as the seed reference image.
Target masks list for seed-to-target counts.
Termination surfaces (e.g. pial) for each hemisphere.

outputs.description: probtrackx2 output directory (fdt_paths, waytotal and seed-to-target counts).

parameters.description: Hemisphere to track (selects the left or right seed and termination files).

citations.text: Bedini M, Olivetti E, Avesani P, Baldauf D. Surface-based Tractography uncovers 'What' and 'Where' Pathways in Prefrontal Cortex. Cortex (2026).
Behrens TEJ, Berg HJ, Jbabdi S, Rushworth MFS, Woolrich MW. Probabilistic diffusion tractography with multiple fibre orientations: What can we gain? NeuroImage 34(1):144-155 (2007).
Hayashi S, et al. brainlife.io: a decentralized and open-source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. Nat Methods (2024).
